title: AI, Growth, and the Future of Healthcare | Anish Acharya & Sachin Jain

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: SCAN Health Plan CEO Sachin Jain speaks with a16z General Partner Anish Acharya about AI, healthcare.
reader_summary.overview: SCAN Health Plan CEO Sachin Jain speaks with a16z General Partner Anish Acharya about AI, healthcare. The conversation explores how AI is reshaping work, customer experience, software development, and organizational structure. Acharya argues that artificial intelligence is not simply another productivity tool, but a fundamentally new technology capable of performing work on behalf of people and organizations.

key_points.text: SCAN Health Plan CEO Sachin Jain speaks with a16z General Partner Anish Acharya about AI, healthcare.
They discuss AI adoption inside large enterprises, the future of customer support, software development, healthcare operations, and why curiosity, experimentation.
Along the way, Acharya shares his views on economic growth, human flourishing.
